validation_failed: Validation failed. Check the entered data.
forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
conflict: This conflicts with the current state.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
cas_conflict: The task was changed by someone else. Reload it and try again.
document_version_conflict: The document was changed since you opened it. Reload it and re-apply your edit.
external_source_conflict: The original document changed since you opened it. Nothing was saved. Reopen it and re-apply your edit.
external_source_write_landed: Your edit reached the original document and will appear here at the next sync.
list_revision_stale: The list changed while you were paging. Start again from the first page.
cursor_expired: The event cursor has expired. Reload the current state.
assignee_not_in_workspace: This assignee is not part of the workspace.
assignee_unresolved: No agent or user matches this assignee.
assignee_refuses_assignments: This agent accepts no assignments. Choose another assignee.
assignment_pinned: The assignee was pinned by a person and cannot be changed automatically.
mention_handoff_required: A mention does not wake an agent. Assign the task and move it to todo instead.
status_change_via_patch_rejected: Status cannot be changed this way. Use the move action.
review_evidence_required: Evidence is required to send this task to review.
done_evidence_required: Evidence is required to close this task.
dod_gate_blocked: The definition of done is not met yet.
triage_entry_requires_human_gate: A task can enter triage only with a question for a person.
park_requires_wakeup: A parked task needs a wake-up condition.
human_gate_frozen: This task is waiting for a person's decision and cannot be changed now.
task_shipped: The task is marked as shipped. Reopen it before moving it.
ambiguous_quote: The quoted text matches several places. Quote a longer fragment.
task_already_checked_out: This task is checked out by someone else. Try again after the checkout expires.
key_rejected: Team Relay rejected the access key. Check the key in the project's Team Relay settings.
foreign_share: This share belongs to a different Team Relay account, so it cannot be mounted.
key_expired: The Team Relay access key has expired. Issue a new key and try again.
unreachable: Team Relay is unreachable. Try again later.
share_not_found: The Team Relay share was not found. Check that it still exists.
error: Team Relay sync failed. Try again later.
